name: Daily order and shipping watcher
why: Finds late and stuck orders each morning and holds risky ones only on the owner's yes, the same job as the daily exception watch workflow.

name: Delivery update flow builder
why: Builds the tracking updates and delay script that sit behind the delay and lost parcel message set.

name: Shipping rate planner
why: Turns parcel costs into checkout zones, rates and a free-shipping line, the last step of the shipping cost review.

name: Order threshold planner
why: Sets free-shipping thresholds at real order peaks, to pair with the checkout rate table.

name: 3PL bid and agreement builder
why: Writes the request for pricing to send before the 3PL quote comparison prompt can put quotes side by side.

name: 3PL bill auditor
why: Checks a 3PL bill against the rates and orders, part of the monthly cost and claims review.

name: Compare freight quotes with all charges
why: Compares freight quotes for one shipment with every charge counted, for pallet and import moves.

name: Landed cost allocator
why: Spreads freight, duty and supplier costs to a true cost per unit, the sheet the customs prep skill builds.

name: Inbound shipment tracker builder
why: A shared tracker for purchase orders and freight coming in, plus the warehouse notice.

name: Monthly returns and refunds reviewer
why: Finds the products driving returns and what returns cost, to feed the returns bench SOP.

name: Returns policy designer
why: Sets refund timing and keep-it rules from returns data, which the returns bench then follows.

name: Support capacity planner
why: Works out support hours and hiring dates for peak from ticket data, like step 3 of the peak season plan.

name: Freight trip contribution builder
why: Works out what one delivery trip earns after fuel, driver and running costs, a deeper version of the cost per drop check.

name: Amazon reimbursement claim finder
why: Finds lost and damaged stock Amazon may owe for, the marketplace side of carrier claims; each claim still needs the client's yes.
